svg.text: where DNS, DoT/DoH, HTTP, HTTPS and HTML filtering each attach · MikroTik RB5009 · RouterOS container · DNS + HTTP deployed today
LAN clients — phones · laptops · TV / IoT
IPv4 192.168.10.0/24 · IPv6 2a02:…/64 — both reach the resolver today
FastAdHunter container — distroless/static · musl · ARM64 · veth1 172.17.0.2 · /config + /data on SSD
Bearer key · TLS · /telemetry is the snapshot
Rule Engine (fah-rules) — one matcher, every plane · allow > block · atomic swap · lock-free hot path
DNS subset — hosts · domains · EasyList / uBlock / AdGuard · $dnstype · $dnsrewrite · compile-time dedup (33 % collapsed)
element / cosmetic rules — parsed and counted today, activated by the HTML rewriter
UDP · TCP · DoT · DoH client — ordered parallel fallback, 800 ms per attempt
element + cosmetic rules · everything else passes through untouched
TOML · env · API · boot vs runtime
QueryEvent channel — bounded, drop-on-full, never blocks the hot path
Rule Engine runs BEFORE the cache and the cache never stores verdicts (ADR-0001) — so a blocked query never reaches the cache, in either plane
Operating mode gates the planes: dns · dns+http (deployed today) → dns+http+https (P3)
reached by the proxy, not the client
Crate layers — dependencies point downward only · siblings never import each other
fastadhunter — binary, wires siblings via channels
fah-http joins fah-dns as a second L3 consumer of the same L2 matcher — that is the whole point of the layering
